limitations: Checks are offline deterministic transport and public Storage fixtures, including explicitly synthetic crash checkpoints; no provider, VM, native Terminal acceptance or full npm check in this subtask.

Public Storage returns each requested record/document as one value: memory is bounded by page and individual value size, not a hard arbitrary-record byte limit. Original detail API returns <=4096 UTF-16 code units, but upstream by-ID JSON decoding still requires the individual record.
